title: ADC Interface
text: Convert analog signal on ADC input pin to digital signal, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Conversion type} sets Type multichannel conversion; {Resolution (bits)} sets the resolution of digital measurement, {Voltage reference (V)} sets the reference voltage in ADC, {Acquisition time (s)} sets the time required for ADC to capture input voltage, {Conversion time (s)} sets the time to convert physical voltage sample to digital value, {Charge/dischard time constant (s)} sets the charge or discharge time constant of the ADC acquisition, {Number of channel}, {Enable interrupt} sets the option to enable interrupt event generation, {Condition}, {Enable analog watchdog} sets the option to enable analog watchdog interrupt event, {Lower threshold}, {Upper threshold} and {Interrupt latency (s)} sets the interrupt generation latency. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: start
ports.summary: Start analog to digital conversion start an analog to digital conversion event

ports.name: wd event
ports.summary: Analog watchdog task event signal scalar

params.name: Acquisition time (s)
params.values: Time required for ADC to capture input voltage 320e-9 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Conversion time (s)
params.values: Time to convert physical voltage sample to digital value 240e-9 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Charge/dischard time constant (s)
params.values: Charge or discharge time constant of the ADC acquisition circuit 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Number of channel
params.values: Number of channels used in multichannel sampling 1 (default) | integer in the range 1 to 16

params.name: Conversion type
params.values: Type multichannel conversion Sequential (default) | Simultaneous | Oversampling

params.name: Enable interrupt
params.values: Option to enable interrupt event generation enable (default) | disable

params.name: Condition
params.values: Condition on when to trigger interrupt Acquisition time (default) | Acquisition + Conversion time

params.name: Enable analog watchdog
params.values: Option to enable analog watchdog interrupt event generation off (default) | on

params.name: Lower threshold
params.values: Lower threshold watchdog trigger 0.1 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Upper threshold
params.values: Upper threshold watchdog trigger 2.9 (default) | real-valued scalar
